note: Outward artifacts WE authored and sent upstream, keyed by the upstream path each concerns. Two consumers, and the difference between them is the whole point. (1) render-site.mjs DISCLOSES on the public page that we filed against a row, so a reader judging that row can see our own hand in it and go read the report. That is a FACT and asserts nothing about cause. (2) check-upstream-reports.mjs (A-33 leg 1) treats a change in `state` since the value recorded here as a CANDIDATE CAUSAL EVENT worth looking at — output is 'go look', never a verdict, because deciding a change was CAUSED by our report is a judgment (A-33 note3).
note2: `state` and `closedAt` are the RECORDED baseline, not a live read. A-33 note4: a check that fires on 'a filed report is closed' fires every day forever once #150 closes, which is this lane's founding defect in a new hat. It must fire on the TRANSITION, so the baseline lives here in the repo and is updated deliberately when a finding is dispositioned. If you update it, say in the commit what you verified.
note3: NOT a G-4 arrival source, and building it must not blur that line. G-4 requires a causal path containing NO artifact we authored and sent; every row in this file is such an artifact by construction, so a hit here is G-3's shape and can never satisfy G-4. If anything this makes the line easier to hold, because it names our own artifacts instead of leaving them unlabelled in the drift stream.
